name: 85044 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85044 (Phoenix) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85044 (Phoenix) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
